fire: Downloads are painfully slow for people on dial-up lines in rural areas.
The squadron trained trainee navigators over the North Sea that spring.
The school hired student teachers for the autumn term.
Service is poor on copper lines outside the big cities.
Their fleet flies with cadet pilots on most short routes.
The hospital relies on trainee nurses during the night shifts.
Calls drop often on landline circuits in this district.
The garage employs apprentice mechanics on Saturdays.
